beats.text: Indonesia reports 0% severe food insecurity. In South Sudan, it is 62.9%.
This counts households forced to skip meals or go whole days without eating due to a lack of money.
Brazil has just 0.6%, while the USA has 1.1%.
Climbing higher: Kenya has 26.5%, Afghanistan has 30.2%, and Haiti has 45.4%.
South Sudan has 16 times the severe food insecurity the UK has. The UK has 4%.
At the very top, South Sudan. 62.9% of the population faces severe hunger.
How would you help end severe hunger?
